exercise.title: Running total on the till
exercise.prompt:
A till adds up the price of every item and prints the total once at the end.

```python
total = 0
for price in [4, 7, 2]:
    total = total + price
print(total)
```

Type exactly what this program prints. One line, no spaces around it.
exercise.referenceSolution: The loop adds 4, then 7, then 2, so the printed total is 13.
